summary: Frontend-only test on /visual (mobile touch context + desktop). Auto-horizontal (rotate) behavior works correctly in all cases. Filter 'Nivel' control still has a real UI overflow: the 'Nivel 2' button escapes its container on narrow portrait viewports (390x844 and 360x740), although it does NOT overlap the numeric 'Score min' field because of the grid gap.

ui_bugs.issue: The three Nivel buttons are NOT equirepartidos and the third button ('Nivel 2') overflows the parent cell horizontally. Measured widths at 390x844 portrait: Ambas=43px, Nivel 1=58px, Nivel 2=58px (sum=159 > container 154). filter-level-n2 right edge = 193 vs container right = 187 (6px overflow). At 360x740: n2 right=193 vs container right=172 (21px overflow). Root cause: buttons use `flex-1 whitespace-nowrap` but flex items have default `min-width: auto`, so `whitespace-nowrap` prevents shrinking below content width and flex-1 cannot equalize. Fix: add `min-w-0` (and probably `truncate` or shorter labels) to the button className, e.g. `min-w-0 basis-0 flex-1 ...`. Note: despite the overflow, no visual overlap with filter-score occurs because the next grid column starts after `gap-4` (at 360, gap only just avoids overlap: n2 right=193 vs filter-score left=188 = 5px encroach into grid gap, but filter-score box does not intersect vertically at same y-range in the current layout).

issues: Nivel button widths not equal (flex-1 not effective due to missing min-w-0); third button visually escapes its cell on portrait <=390px

action_items: Fix filter-level buttons in /app/frontend/src/pages/Visual.jsx around line 884: add `min-w-0` to the button className so `flex-1` can actually equalize widths and prevent horizontal overflow of the container on narrow mobile widths (<=390px). Optionally add `basis-0` or shorten labels ('N1'/'N2') for narrow screens.
critical_code_review_comments: Visual.jsx ~L884: `flex-1 ... whitespace-nowrap` without `min-w-0` is a common Tailwind pitfall — flex children default to min-width:auto and won't shrink below content size, breaking equal partitioning.
Visual.jsx ~L284: auto-horizontal effect correctly uses resize+orientationchange with `pointer:coarse` + short-side<=560 heuristic. Verified working end-to-end via Playwright rotation simulation.

Remaining bug: Nivel buttons overflow container on <=390px portrait; fix by adding min-w-0 to button className. Re-measure filter-level-both/n1/n2 bounding boxes and container after fix.
